content:
Sam (CS): quick sync on Guava renewal — procurement sent an unsigned PO but wants to pay by card. missing: signed PO pdf, legal entity full name, VAT cert. tagging @Ellen @Marco
Ellen (Sales): buyer says card ok for month1 if we show invoice sample with VAT line and their legal name. they provided provisional vendor code GVA-EU-11. finance flagged mismatch with registry name.
Marco (Legal): for NL/DE entities we need signed PO or delegated signer. i can accept a 1-line addendum committing to deliver signed PO + VAT cert within 10 days. will draft.
Riley (Ops): ops needs exact legal name (no dba), billing email, and SOW attached before final provisioning. temporary card charge ok if addendum signed; seats can be provisional.
Sam (CS): PO snippet from buyer DM:
```
PO#: G-2026-77 (unsigned)
Bill To: Guava BV
Seats: 60
Term: 12mo
Total: EUR 18,000
Billing contact: ap@guava.io
Vendor code: GVA-EU-11 (provisional)
```
Sam (CS): buyer claims reverse-charge VAT; asked for VAT cert + company extract.
billing-bot: draft invoice INV-3311 created (EUR 18,000) — status: draft, missing SOW. link: https://billing.internal/INV-3311
Ellen (Sales): propose card tokenization for month1 only with conditions: 1) sign addendum 2) signed PO + VAT cert in 10 days 3) card covers month1 non-refundable. legal ok?
Marco (Legal): fine. addendum will include: "Buyer commits to deliver signed PO and VAT certificate within 10 calendar days; failure may result in suspension of subsequent provisioning."
Riley (Ops): ops will provision seats on successful charge but mark onboarding as conditional until docs arrive. won't enable production access until SOW attached.
Sam (CS): action items: Sam request VAT cert + signed PO + company extract. Ellen escalate to buyer exec if delayed. Marco to drop addendum. Riley prepare provisioning flag.
Ellen (Sales): pinged buyer finance. they replied: "legal might take 7-10 business days."
Sam (CS): customer-facing message sent offering card + addendum. buyer asked if an email from CFO + company extract is acceptable as interim.
Marco (Legal): CFO email + extract acceptable as intent confirmation only; still need signed PO or delegation.
billing-bot: scheduled: if no signed PO by 2026-07-01T09:00Z, create proforma PRO-3311 and attempt card capture at 09:15Z.
